text:
You will often look for creatures or
items, or general information
about the mysteries around you.
Whenever you enter a box and you
play an encounter, or there is
nothing in the box, you may
perform a Search roll. Write an S in
the box as a reminder that you
searched it. You have only one
chance of searching each box.
Exceptions: you may NOT Search a
Safe House. You may Search a
library multiple times, but the only
thing you can find is a book or 1
Clue. To perform a Search, roll d6
on the Search table below. Add +1
if you have the Investigator Skill, or
+2 if you have Investigator (Expert).
A roll of 1 remains a 1: do not add
modifiers if you roll a 1.

1 Roll on the random encounter table, p.39.
2-5 Nothing found.
6 Success! Roll 4 times on the Useful Items table or on the
Random Object table, and pick a single result; OR  gain 1 Clue.
Roll at +1 if you have the Investigator Skill, +2 if you have
Investigator (Expert). A roll of 1 remains a 1.

zh-CN.title: 搜索检定
text: 你经常需要寻找生物、物品，或有关谜团的信息。进入一个格子并完成遭遇，或该格没有任何内容时，可以进行一次搜索检定。在格子里写下S作为已搜索标记；每格只有一次搜索机会。例外：不能搜索安全屋。图书馆可搜索多次，但每次只能找到一本书或1点线索。搜索时掷搜索表所示D6。拥有调查员技能+1，专家级调查员+2。掷出1仍为1，不加修正。

1 掷随机遭遇表（第39页）。
2–5 一无所获。
6 成功！在有用物品表或随机物品表上掷4次，并从结果中选1项；或者获得1点线索。拥有调查员技能时检定+1，专家级调查员+2。掷出1仍为1。
